messages.subject: Save audio to local directory?
parts:
So any chance that Shiny R will save audio and text input in a local directory. For example here is a server function that I'm hoping would record and save a wav file:

server <- function(input, output) {


data <- eventReactive(input$run, {

library(audio)

Filename <- input$ID

# record audio

x <- rep(NA_real_, 40000)

# start recording into x

record(x, 8000, 2)


# save audio locally THIS DOES NOT WORK

save.wave(x, paste( input$ID,".wav",sep=""))


# create a label file for the sound, NEITHER DOES THIS

saveRDS( input$label, file=paste(Filename,".lab",sep=""), ascii=TRUE, compress=FALSE )

})

}

messages.subject: Re: Save audio to local directory?
parts:
Yes, observerEvent was right, here is relevant part that worked:

observeEvent(input$record, {
# record audio
x <- rep(NA_real_, 44100*2*3) # for 3 seconds
# start recording into x

wait(record(x, 44100, 2)) 
# save audio with name attached
save.wave(x, paste( input$name,".wav",sep=""))
})
